Page 22 Cont.
Jan. 29 Seuge Berger - 34- missing in action over Luxemburg .... Babe Carol Ann Perttola - 6 mo. - very serious stomach trouble . parents reported as not too practical .... .
Cha's R. Avery - 40 - English Lutheran - losing sight - one eye hemoraging five years and the other 22.
Mrs. Eugene Matthew - 81 - threatening tumor.
Page 23 Jan. 31 Rita Dahman - 23 - peculiar sist-like groth on side of Rt. Eye since birth. Seem growing of late ....
February
1945, February
Feb. 1 Mrs. Edith McMahan - 62 - Eye and face twiching, has to go out working ...... Embarising enrolls To-night.
2 Frances Mooney - 19 - diabetis since 5 yrs. old ..... now turning to drink .. ...
3 Geo Pope - Greek Orthodox ... 7 - brain injury at birth ... "no cure" Dr's say. Enrolled perpetually To-day. Mother prepares to be earn- est in finding out relationship between the Mother Church and the "Orthodox" if child improve.
5 Gus Mortos - 59 - Greek Orthodox but hardly believes in anything. However, does not object to wife's . ... She enrolls him To-day 5.
Page 24
Feb. 5 Joseph Malik - 4 - bright and happy - trying continually to sing but to the great disapointment to all can not form words.
5 Shirley Richer - 9 - rhumatic fever to be anointed To-morrow. Seems happy a thought of this holy sacrament for the sick and dying. Tells Mother to give all her clothes away because she'll not need them any more. Mrs. Alice Pozzin - 40 - lost right-breast some time back; now ad- monished to have the other removed - Enrolls for year promising perpet'1.
Feb. 7 Mrs. Jennie Palmer Frazer - in her 80's - Episcopilian - in Fords Hospital -malignancy in kidnies feared.
